context: A teacher reviews a teen project
purpose: Teach: 骨折/腎臓/専門医/倒壊/冤罪/気象庁/運航/収束

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、防災研究、骨折リスク、よく調べましたね。
lines.en: Sakura, you did some thorough research on disaster preparedness and fracture risk.
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Slow, measured pace. Genuine appreciation in the tone — not performative praise. Eyes engaged.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。高齢者の腎臓疾患併発、注意点として書きました。
lines.en: Yes. I noted kidney complications in elderly people as something to watch for.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Direct eye contact. Steady pace — not rushed, not defensive. A student who knows her work holds up.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 専門医のインタビュー、貴重ですね。
lines.en: Those specialist interviews were really valuable.
lines.style: Slight lean forward. Genuine surprise underneath — she wasn't expecting this depth. Warm, not exaggerating. A beat of pause before 'valuable'.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 家屋倒壊リスク、地域別データを使いました。
lines.en: I used regional data to map out the building-collapse risk.
lines.style: Steady, methodical delivery. Pride beneath the surface — not boastful, just the quiet satisfaction of work done well. Even pacing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 冤罪に近い噂被害、二次被害として扱う視点、優れてますね。
lines.en: The way you framed rumor-related harm as a secondary disaster — that's a really sophisticated angle.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause at the opening. Soft emphasis on 'sophisticated.' Genuine intellectual engagement — talking to Sakura as a peer thinker, not a student. Slight nod.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 気象庁の警報、利活用、章にまとめました。
lines.en: I pulled together a chapter on how to use JMA alerts effectively.
lines.style: Modest but steady. Matter-of-fact delivery without apology. The tone of someone presenting something she knows is solid.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 交通機関の運航、収束までの記録、丁寧でしたね。
lines.en: The way you tracked transit operations through to when things stabilized — that level of care shows.
lines.style: Soft closing. Genuine warmth. Not effusive — measured and real. A small smile in the voice. Asuka signaling: I see you, and this work matters.
